sql:
SELECT f.CDSCode, f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS FRPM_Rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Charter = 66
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5
